_about: Development Engagement Lab (Harvard Dataverse, CC0 1.0), Great Britain files. Candidate experiments read from the YouGov survey scripts on 2026-10-10, before triage.
status: take = looks ready; check = versions sit in page or module blocks and need reading. Image and video experiments (Sandbox Jun 2021, Oct 2023) are parked, not listed here.
